title: Realm of Harmony

scene_beats.setting: Lush forest of vivid color, first color in the game. Glowing creatures drift like lit paper lanterns.
scene_beats.action: Arin steps out of gray ink into color. Zeref's eyes fill with stars.

scene_beats.setting: Clearing ringed by glowing moss. A tall spirit made of soft light lines, face like a calm sketch.
scene_beats.action: The Wise Spirit of Harmony greets them. Villagers bring shards.

scene_beats.setting: Same clearing. Above Mote's head, a tiny speech bubble pops in with a drawing of a sock.
scene_beats.action: New mechanic: Mote's thoughts now appear as drawings in bubbles.

zeref_moment: Zeref's first bubble: a fish wearing his own beanie.

title: Grove in Chaos

scene_beats.setting: Grove twisted into black brambles. Thorns cross-hatched so dense the page looks scratched out.
scene_beats.action: Twelve villagers stand at the edge, too scared to go in alone.

scene_beats.setting: Circle of twelve on moss inside the thorns. Breath ring pulses in the middle like a slow heartbeat.
scene_beats.action: Large-scale Attunement: hold the breath ring in time with all 12.

scene_beats.setting: Vines unwind, petals open gold. Three runes glow on the ground: protection, growth, illumination.
scene_beats.action: The spirit's words. A hidden path opens past the runes.

rooms.description: Thorn tunnel, gaps open and close like slow teeth.
rooms.puzzle: Walk only while the breath ring is on 'out'; thorns relax then.

rooms.description: Bramble maze around three dim rune stones.
rooms.puzzle: Point at each rune in order: protection, growth, illumination.

rooms.description: Heart of the grove: a tangle with twelve hand-shaped knots.
rooms.puzzle: Boss room. Each freed villager joins the circle.

boss.name: The Grove in Chaos (Thorn Tangle)
boss.mechanic: Not a fight to win by hitting. Free villagers from thorns, then hold the 12-person breath ring to unwind the tangle.

idle_animation.description: Brambles creak inward and out, slow as a sleeper's chest.

phases.transformation: A knot of thorns the size of a house, twelve villagers stuck in its hatching.

attacks.name: Bramble Wall
attacks.effect: Wall cuts the arena in half

phases.transformation: The tangle grows up the trees and over the sky; the page darkens.

attacks.name: Choke Ring
attacks.telegraph: Ring of thorns forms around the circle

phases.transformation: Every vine rears at once into a giant thorn-face with hollow eyes.

defeat_animation.description: Vines unwind, petals open, gold pollen rises, a bee flies out, grove breathes.

boss.canon: bible 3.2 Grove in Chaos (12-person Attunement breath); grove encounter, Attunable, not a bible numbered boss
boss.sprite_note: Uses biome bramble tiles; no new big sprite needed beyond the thorn-face.

zeref_moment: Zeref exhales at last. The whole grove smells of honey.

title: The Petal Tree

scene_beats.setting: Gnarled ancient tree, bark like crumpled paper. Iridescent petals drift down, each with one word.
scene_beats.action: Arin looks up. Three petals glow brighter than the rest.

scene_beats.setting: Branches as platforms, wind lines drawn in pencil. A petal tumbles past the trunk.
scene_beats.action: Short platforming: jump branch to branch, chase each petal on the wind.

scene_beats.setting: Base of the tree, three petals glowing in Arin's palm. A crack opens in the trunk.
scene_beats.action: Unity floats down on its own and lands on Mote's head.

zeref_moment: Zeref spits out the Courage petal. Unharmed. Proud.

title: Gateway of Trials
location: Gateway of Trials, Portal of Symbols

scene_beats.setting: Wide plain inside the trunk, sky drawn in soft pencil. Three cloaked figures stand far apart.
scene_beats.action: The Gateway Figures speak as one. Trials can be done in any order.

scene_beats.setting: Trial of Wisdom: a crystal orb on a pillar, riddle written in light. Night sky above.
scene_beats.action: Riddle: born of light in darkness, fleeting but eternal. Point at the sky.

scene_beats.setting: Portal of Symbols: three trial marks burning on a stone ring. Color swirls into a forest clearing.
scene_beats.action: After the Unity show (laughter, applause), the portal opens to an altar.

rooms.description: Trial of Wisdom: orb pillar under a night sky.
rooms.puzzle: Point at the shooting star when it crosses. Wrong points dim the orb.

rooms.description: Trial of Unity: a stage with 6 slots and a bickering crowd.
rooms.puzzle: Place musicians, artists, storytellers; neighbors must harmonize.

rooms.description: Trial of Courage: dark arena, shadows wearing your failures.
rooms.puzzle: Boss room. You cannot hurt them; walk toward them.

boss.name: The Shadows of Failure, Loss and Loneliness (Trial of Courage)
boss.mechanic: You cannot hurt them. Walk toward them; every step forward pushes back the dark. Stepping back lets them grow.

idle_animation.description: Three tall shadows sway, edges smudged, eyes two white dots.

phases.transformation: Three shadows Arin's height: Failure, Loss, Loneliness.

attacks.name: Whisper
attacks.telegraph: A shadow leans in, text grays

phases.transformation: They merge and double in height; the arena edges fold inward.

attacks.name: Wall of Doubt
attacks.effect: Wide sweep, sidestep and keep walking

phases.transformation: One giant shadow filling the sky, only its eyes left white.

attacks.name: Lonely Dark
attacks.effect: Walk alone 5 steps; Mote bubble guides

animation.description: Fade Bryn, fade Quillan, fade Edric, dark, bubble, step

defeat_animation.description: Each step cracks the shadow; light leaks through; it scatters into moths.

boss.canon: bible 3.5b Trial of Courage; trial encounter, not a bible numbered boss

zeref_moment: Zeref takes a bow on stage. Nobody asked. Big applause.

title: The Twilight Gift

scene_beats.setting: Forest clearing, ancient stone altar glowing. A sudden gust bends every tree on the page.
scene_beats.action: The altar's glow blows out. A voice whispers from nowhere.

scene_beats.setting: Twilight grove: half the page day, half night, seam glowing purple-gold. A cloaked figure waits.
scene_beats.action: The Dusk Keeper hands Arin a small box. Inside is a note.

scene_beats.setting: Realm of Dreams: lavender sky, playful creatures. A stone pedestal holds a map of four glowing spots.
scene_beats.action: Twilight Mark glows blue-green on Arin's palm. Tibbet flutters in.

zeref_moment: Zeref sits right on the twilight seam. Half day. Half night.

title: Crystal of Balance

scene_beats.setting: Heartwood Woods at misty dawn. Huge tree, runes carved in its bark, mist low on the ground.
scene_beats.action: Tibbet reads the runes aloud, then hides behind Arin.

scene_beats.setting: Glade of dawn feathers. The Guardian, half human half beast, covered in swirling patterns.
scene_beats.action: Riddle boss. Wrong answers summon dawn-feather adds.

scene_beats.setting: Crystal of Balance rises from roots. A dry river channel fills with clear water, rushing.
scene_beats.action: Mote echoes the answer three times, quieter each time. Geonwater flows.

rooms.description: Misty root path; runes glow when you speak.
rooms.puzzle: Answer rune riddles by Pointing at the right object.

rooms.description: Echo hollow, every sound comes back late.
rooms.puzzle: Hum; follow the echo that returns first to find the path.

rooms.description: Dawn glade under the rune tree.

boss.name: The Guardian of Dawn's Whisper
boss.mechanic: Riddle boss: a correct answer halves its Heart; a wrong one summons dawn-feather adds. Answering 'echo' resolves it.

idle_animation.description: Swirling patterns on its skin rotate slowly; breath makes mist rings.

phases.transformation: Half human, half beast, Arin's height x2, patterns turning like a dawn sky.

attacks.name: Dawn Feathers
attacks.telegraph: Arms spread, feathers lift from patterns

phases.transformation: It grows to tree height; patterns spill off its body and swirl around the glade.

attacks.name: Whisper Storm
attacks.effect: Riddle text circles; wrong Point summons 2 adds

attacks.name: Sunrise Beam
attacks.telegraph: A gold line splits its chest

defeat_animation.description: Patterns slow and still, it bows, dissolves into dawn mist, crystal remains.

boss.canon: bible boss #6 (Heartwood Woods, Act III, Heart 2,000, 2 phases, Attunable riddle boss)

zeref_moment: Zeref joins the echo: rawr, rawr, rawr, softer each time.

title: Crystal of Clarity

scene_beats.setting: Glacial Grotto: ice sculptures of past heroes, drips echoing, faint blue glow, deep navy shadows.
scene_beats.action: Cold drains Light. Arin walks past frozen heroes holding frozen swords.

scene_beats.setting: Frozen lake hall, ice pillars. Rime the Ice Wolf circles, breath freezing into pillars.
scene_beats.action: Rime attacks. Dodge, never strike, for 30 seconds.

scene_beats.setting: Rime turns to mist and touches a frozen pool. Crystal rises. Threads of light connect distant faces.
scene_beats.action: Visions of fate's threads across worlds. The Tigra runs again.

rooms.description: Hall of hero sculptures; ice floor shines.
rooms.puzzle: Slide puzzle: push hero statues onto pressure ice.

rooms.description: Dripping echo cave; each drip lights a tile.
rooms.puzzle: Memorize the drip-light order; cold drains Light if slow.

rooms.description: Frozen lake hall with ice pillars.

boss.name: Rime, the Ice Wolf
boss.mechanic: Fierce at first. Never attack for 30 seconds while dodging and Agitation falls. Attacking resets the timer and enrages it.

idle_animation.description: Paces in a slow arc, breath frosting the air, ice hackles rise.

phases.transformation: A wolf twice Arin's size, fur like cracked ice, eyes pale blue.

attacks.name: Ice Pillars
attacks.telegraph: Howls, floor cracks in a line

phases.transformation: Rime grows huge as the hall; ice armor grows over its back like a glacier.

attacks.name: Glacier Charge
attacks.effect: Charge across the lake, ice breaks behind

attacks.name: Blizzard Howl
attacks.effect: Screen fogs, pillars rise at random

animation.description: Howl, fog, pillar, pillar, pillar, settle

defeat_animation.description: Armor cracks off, wolf shrinks, sighs, turns to mist, mist touches pool.

boss.canon: bible boss #7 (Glacial Grotto, Act III, Heart 3,500, 2 phases, Attunable: never attack for 30s)

zeref_moment: Zeref sits calmly in front of the angry wolf. It works.

title: Crystal of Passion

scene_beats.setting: Ember Caverns: magma pools in thick gouache, obsidian platforms, shadows flicker on every wall.
scene_beats.action: Heat drains Ink. A voice crackles from the magma.

scene_beats.setting: Obsidian anvil on an island of rock, flames rising around it. Cinderwake the Phoenix overhead.
scene_beats.action: Phase 3: forge anything at the anvil while flames rise. Rhythm judged.

scene_beats.setting: A mirror of black glass by the anvil. It shows Arin standing tall in firelight.
scene_beats.action: Arin whispers to the mirror. The Euphra burns bright again.

rooms.puzzle: Platforms sink after 2 sec; heat drains Ink, move fast.

rooms.description: Forge-shadow hall, flames cast moving shadows.
rooms.puzzle: Stand in a shadow only when the flame dips; reach the bellows.

rooms.description: Anvil island ringed by rising fire.

boss.name: Cinderwake, the Phoenix
boss.mechanic: A test of will. P1 wing sweeps, P2 Ink-draining heat rings, P3 forge any item at the anvil; rhythm accuracy is judged, not the item.

idle_animation.description: Hovers, wings beat slow, embers drift up from every feather.

phases.transformation: A phoenix with a wingspan wider than the anvil island.

attacks.name: Ember Dive
attacks.effect: Dives at your spot, fire puddle

phases.transformation: Flames double; wings now span the whole cavern ceiling.
Cinderwake becomes pure flame, a fire-sun hanging over the anvil.

attacks.name: Show Me Your Heart
attacks.effect: Forge minigame; missed beats raise fire

animation.description: Rise, beat, beat, beat, judge, hush

defeat_animation.description: Flames shrink to a gentle bird, bows, drops a feather, crystal glows red.

boss.canon: bible boss #8 (Ember Caverns, Act III, Heart 4,000, 3 phases, Attunable test of will)

zeref_moment: Zeref warms his paws at the phoenix. It allows this.

title: Crystal of Harmony

scene_beats.setting: Celestial Peaks: stars sit on the ground like pebbles. Thin air. Violet and star-white.
scene_beats.action: Arin climbs. Falling stars streak past. Pace slows in the thin air.

scene_beats.setting: Summit. A perfect white figure, beautiful, no flicker. The stars cast shadows. It casts none.
scene_beats.action: The Counterfeit Angel offers rest. Mote hides behind Arin and growls.

scene_beats.setting: Summit after. Crystal of Harmony on a star-pebble cairn. A long dusk shadow falls across the peak.
scene_beats.action: Arin uses Dusk Walk to give it a shadow, then strikes the shadow.

rooms.description: Switchback trail; stars like pebbles, some falling.
rooms.puzzle: Point at a star's glint to read where it lands; dodge.

rooms.description: Thin-air ledge, Twilight Shrine at the edge.

attack_animation.description: Holds lamp up (1), white flash (2), still (3).

rooms.puzzle: Dusk Walk the shrine; real lights cast shadows, fake ones do not.

rooms.description: Summit cairn where stars touch the earth.

boss.name: The Counterfeit Angel
boss.mechanic: Casts no shadow, untouchable. Its attacks heal you, then put you to sleep (Stilling). Smudge or Dusk Walk give it a shadow; hit the shadow.

idle_animation.description: Floats perfectly still. No flicker. That is the creepy part.

phases.transformation: A kind white figure, Arin's size, arms open. No shadow.
Grows tall as the peak, wings of white paper fan out behind it.

attacks.name: Rest Now
attacks.effect: Sleep zone; Mote growl wakes you

attacks.name: Perfect Rain
attacks.effect: White motes freeze what they touch

phases.transformation: A sky-sized white light; the whole page is becoming a finished drawing.

attacks.name: The Finished Drawing
attacks.effect: Stilling rises fast; Dusk Walk now

animation.description: Drain, outline, fill, freeze, frame, hush

attacks.name: Halo Ring
attacks.effect: Ring of light sweeps the summit

defeat_animation.description: Long dusk shadow pins it; it cracks like glass, flees as white dust.

boss.canon: bible boss #9 (Celestial Peaks, Act III, Heart 5,000, 3 phases; first appearance; weakness shadow)
boss.sprite_note: Same sprite returns in Act V (Day 2) and as Malakar Phase 2; keep palette shared.

zeref_moment: Zeref growls with Mote. Two tiny growls, one big no.

title: Rivers Remember

scene_beats.setting: Heart chamber. The cracked Heart floats, four empty sockets glowing faintly. Edric holds his journal.
scene_beats.action: Arin sets the four crystals: Balance, Clarity, Passion, Harmony.

scene_beats.setting: Montage: Pages from your own save. Frozen rivers start moving on each one at once.
scene_beats.action: Every river in the Folio runs. Mote glows and grows: Wash rendering.

scene_beats.setting: The Heart, mended. One hairline crack left, thin as a pencil line, glowing faintly.
scene_beats.action: Edric notes it in his journal. Nobody says anything for a moment.

zeref_moment: Zeref licks the Heart's crack. It does not heal. Still cute.
